paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.

model_annotations.English: This bar chart, titled "QAdapter," compares the GPU memory consumption (in GB) of various fine-tuning methods for the Llama-3-8B model across ten NLP tasks. The vertical axis is labeled "GPU Memory (GB)" and shows a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70 GB, marked with ticks at intervals of 20 GB (0, 20, 40, 60). The horizontal axis lists the fine-tuning methods: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, Adapter, QAdapter, and Ours. Each method is represented by a single bar, all uniformly colored orange except for "Ours," which is green. The bars are sorted from left to right in descending order of GPU memory usage. The Full FT method consumes the most memory, reaching approximately 72 GB. MTL-FT follows with about 43 GB, TAG uses around 19 GB, Adapter uses roughly 17 GB, and QAdapter uses approximately 8 GB. The "Ours" method consumes about 19 GB, matching TAG’s memory usage and significantly less than Full FT and MTL-FT. The green bar for "Ours" is visually distinct, likely emphasizing its performance relative to other methods.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart, titled "QAdapter," compares GPU memory consumption (in GB) across six different fine-tuning methods for the Llama-3-8B model on ten NLP tasks. The vertical axis represents GPU Memory (GB), ranging from 0 to 60 in increments of 20, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the methods in the following order: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, Adapter, QAdapter, and Ours. Each method is represented by a single bar, with the first five bars colored orange and the last bar (Ours) colored green. The GPU memory usage decreases from left to right: Full FT consumes approximately 68 GB, MTL-FT around 45 GB, TAG about 22 GB, Adapter roughly 20 GB, and QAdapter approximately 10 GB. The proposed method, "Ours," uses about 15 GB of GPU memory, which is slightly higher than QAdapter but significantly lower than the other methods. The bars are arranged in descending order of memory usage, except for the last bar, which is visually distinct in color and slightly higher than QAdapter, indicating a small increase in memory cost compared to QAdapter but still substantially lower than the full fine-tuning approaches.
